tbesh_html:
1) bulb, knob, capital, capital of a pillar
1a) knob, bulb (as ornament)
1b) capital (of a pillar)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of acolumn, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum
strongs_1890.derivation: or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle;
